title: Strop
summary: STROP, noun 1. A strap. [See Strap.] This orthography is particularly used for a strip of lether used for sharpening razors and giving them a fine smooth edge; a razor-strop. But strap is preferable.

inlines.v: STROP, noun 1. A strap. [See Strap.] This orthography is particularly used for a strip of lether used for sharpening razors and giving them a fine smooth edge; a razor-strop. But strap is preferable. 2. A piece of rope spliced into a circular wreath, and put round a block for hanging it.
